validity: study_valid only if every gating control passes. Otherwise the repaired classification is still computed and reported, labelled INVALID with the failed controls named, and no repaired decision is stated.
failure_policy: All failed, unconverged, partial, not-started and model-domain-exit arms are saved with their native status and never repaired, rerun or replaced. A context with any such repaired arm is not_assessable for the repaired variant, exactly as fidelity-v1. The fidelity-v1 results (45 arms, 27 sign_resolved, all decisions undetermined) are preserved unchanged; production decisions stay those.

expectations_not_criteria: From cfd04's repaired four-fin span family (nc 8: 0.25466 at 16, 0.25018 at 32, 0.24793 at 64; successive-step ratios about 0.5-0.6) and its flat chord plateau, the repaired rigid-CL T2 triple is expected monotone with observed order near 1. This is an expectation from rigid solves, not a prediction for coupled effects.
Whether paired coupled effects resolve, and whether chi0.8-u20 stays inside the 0.1 tip/span gate, is not predicted.
decision_relevance: If the repaired effects resolve, the v1 rules give bending retain/reject and feedback one-way/two-way decisions CONDITIONAL on the diagnostic collocation variant, which would justify a separate, labelled production VLM change by its owner; they do not change production decisions by themselves. If they do not resolve, the remaining irregularity is shown not to be the collocation mismatch alone on this ladder, and a finer ladder is not the remedy. Either way the repaired-baseline difference bounds how much the production collocation biases each coupled effect at these lattices.
